objective: Close X3/X4 Apple Silicon primitives as verified gated primitives: privacy-scoped prefix/KV cache and adaptive MTP scheduler, without wiring either into a production provider.

criteria.promise: X3 prefix/KV cache is in-memory only, keyed by schema/model revision/privacy scope/boundary/prefix digest, rejects invalid or oversized entries, expires stale data, evicts by resource limits, and exposes metrics without prompts, paths, tokens or digests.

X4 MTP scheduler starts in ordinary decoding, requires capability plus warm-up evidence, adapts only across configured compiled draft variants, resets on model revision, and falls back on memory pressure, failures, low acceptance or unproven speedup.
Neither X3 nor X4 is wired into a production LiteRT provider; they remain local primitives/spike decisions until a runtime executor exposes stable KV/MTP contracts.

verification_gates.procedure: Run swift test --filter BELPrefixKVCacheTests and inspect cache source/docs.
verification_gates.expected: Privacy isolation, rejection, LRU/byte eviction, expiration and scoped removal all pass.

verification_gates.procedure: Run swift test --filter BELMTPSchedulerTests and inspect scheduler source/docs.
verification_gates.expected: Capability/memory gates, warm-up, evidence-backed speculation, step-up/down, failure fallback, revision reset and invalid observations all pass.

verification_gates.procedure: Search production package/provider sources for LiteRT/provider wiring or user-visible feature flags.
verification_gates.expected: Only gated primitives/docs mention LiteRT/MTP; no production provider or feature flag is registered.

recon_evidence: X3/X4 docs, primitives and tests were inspected. This ticket accepts only fail-closed primitives and explicitly forbids production provider wiring. The missing production LiteRT executor contract is a known integration gate documented in the spike docs, not an unresolved unknown for this closure.

first_checkpoint.evidence: Focused Swift tests and product-source absence search.
